label: Intellectual property compromise / technical data theft
source_trace: Y §4 (threat category: theft of technical data). K §4.1.1 Intellectual property compromise.
label_applies_when: Direct where the technical data is taken from or through an AM product that stores, transmits or processes it (3.1.1 and the interface-based routes of 3.1.2).
not_covered: Reconstruction from a lawfully obtained part. Ownership and enforcement of IP rights.

label: Unauthorised production / counterfeit / restricted-part production
source_trace: K §4.1.2 Unauthorised part production. Y Fig. 4 names illegal part manufacturing but excludes it from its taxonomy.
label_applies_when: Reached part: access control, integrity of authorisation and configuration data, and logging in an AM product that gates production, against anyone other than the product's user.
not_covered: Licensing, counterfeiting, export control and grey-market trade as such. Production by the product's own user.

label: Data breach and data manipulation
source_trace: K §4.1.3 Data breach and manipulation. No goal-level counterpart in Y.
label_applies_when: Any AM product that stores, transmits or processes the design, process, quality or control data concerned.
not_covered: Access or changes authorised by the product's user.

label: Sabotage / integrity degradation
source_trace: Y §5 (threat category: AM sabotage). K §4.1.4 Sabotage.
label_applies_when: Direct where the sabotage is carried out by manipulating data, commands, programs or configuration of an AM product, or by compromising the product itself.
not_covered: Purely physical or material sabotage (see 3.7.2 and 3.6.2).

label: Availability disruption / denial of service
source_trace: K §4.1.5 Denial of service. Related in Y: §5.1.2 (cyber infrastructure, availability) and §5.1.4 (first-order effects). K's non-adversarial sub-threats are kept as exploit conditions (Section 7.2).
label_applies_when: Direct where the availability of essential or basic functions of an AM product is attacked (point 2(h)), or where a compromised AM product degrades other devices or networks (point 2(i)).
not_covered: Natural disasters, power infrastructure, logistics, material and environmental disruption.

label: Design and specification assets
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge (AM lifecycle zone). Groups Y §4.1.1 and K §4.2.1, §4.2.9 to §4.2.11.
label_applies_when: All leaves carry this label. See the leaf rows.
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Part specification
source_trace: Y §4.1.1 Part specification (theft target) and §5.2.1 (specification as manipulated element). K §4.2.1 3D design and part specification.
label_applies_when: Design repository, CAD or build-preparation software, workflow platform or printer that holds the specification as data.
not_covered: None beyond the general limits of Section C.4.

label: CAD model integrity
source_trace: K §4.2.9 CAD model integrity.
label_applies_when: CAD software, design repository or platform that stores or processes the model.
not_covered: None beyond the general limits of Section C.4.

label: STL / AMF / 3MF / intermediate model integrity
source_trace: K §4.2.10 STL phase integrity. AMF and 3MF are named in Y §4.1.1 (part geometry).
label_applies_when: Conversion tool, slicer, repository or platform that stores, converts or transmits the intermediate model.
not_covered: Metadata that a file format drops by design. That loss is not an attack and is not a node of this taxonomy.

label: Tool-path / slicing output / machine-instruction integrity
source_trace: K §4.2.11 Tool-path execution. Y §4.2.2 treats tool-path commands as an eavesdropping source.
label_applies_when: Slicer, job-transfer channel, machine-control software or firmware that generates, transmits or executes the instructions.
not_covered: None beyond the general limits of Section C.4.

label: Process knowledge and production recipe assets
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge. Groups Y §4.1.2 to §4.1.4, §5.2.3 and K §4.2.2 to §4.2.4.
annex_i_requirements: Annex I.I(2)(d), (e), (f), (h), (l); Annex VII points 2 and 3
label_applies_when: Leaves differ: Direct (2.2.1, 2.2.2, 2.2.5); Conditional (2.2.3, 2.2.4, 2.2.6).
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Manufacturing process specification
source_trace: Y §4.1.2 Manufacturing process specification. K §4.2.2 Manufacturing process covers it in part.
label_applies_when: Slicer, machine-profile store, workflow platform or printer that holds the parameter set as configuration or data.
not_covered: None beyond the general limits of Section C.4.

label: Manufacturing process execution
source_trace: Execution aspect of K §4.2.2 Manufacturing process (process tampering, system access). Y §5.2.3 (process control). Split from 2.2.1 to separate recipe knowledge from live control.
label_applies_when: Machine-control software and firmware of the AM equipment during the build.
not_covered: None beyond the general limits of Section C.4.

label: Post-processing specification
source_trace: Y §4.1.3 Post-processing specification. Specification aspect of K §4.2.3 Post-processing stage, which is recorded as a split source mapping.
annex_i_requirements: Annex I.I(2)(d), (e), (f), (l); Annex VII points 2 and 3
label_applies_when: Direct where the recipe, programme or inspection configuration is held in, or loaded into, a digitally controlled post-processing or inspection product.
not_covered: Paper or verbal work instructions for manual post-processing.

label: Post-processing execution
source_trace: Execution aspect of K §4.2.3 Post-processing stage. Y §5.2.4 Post-processing (as manipulated step). Split from 2.2.3 so that theft of recipes is not conflated with attacks on live execution.
annex_i_requirements: Annex I.I(2)(d), (f), (h), (j), (k), (l); Annex VII points 2, 3, and 6
label_applies_when: Direct where the step is executed or monitored by digitally controlled equipment, such as a furnace or HIP controller, a CNC or EDM machine, or an inspection system.
not_covered: Manual operations and physical handling.

label: Sensor information and quality-control data
source_trace: Y §5.2.3 (sensor information, a method branch in Y, recast here as the asset that is manipulated) and Y §5.2.5 (compromised quality control).
annex_i_requirements: Annex I.I(2)(e), (f), (h), (l); Annex VII points 2, 3, and 6
label_applies_when: Printer, in-situ monitoring system or quality software that produces, transmits or stores the readings and records.
not_covered: None beyond the general limits of Section C.4.

label: Indirect manufacturing dependencies
source_trace: Y §4.1.4 Indirect manufacturing (tooling and moulds made by AM). K §4.2.4 Indirect manufacturing dependencies (suppliers, logistics, infrastructure). The two source nodes overlap only in part, see Section 10.
label_applies_when: Direct where the dependency is itself a product with digital elements, an integrated component (Article 13(5)) or remote data processing (Article 3(2)).
not_covered: Tooling, moulds, suppliers, power supply and other non-digital dependencies.

label: Supply-chain assets and dependencies
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge. Groups Y §5.2.2 (as attacked assets) and K's supply-chain stages.
label_applies_when: Leaves differ: Direct (2.3.3, 2.3.4); Conditional (2.3.2, 2.3.5, 2.3.6); Partial (2.3.1).
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Feedstock / source materials
source_trace: Y §5.2.2 (feedstock). K §4.2.2 (material substitution, infiltration of the material supply chain).
legal_anchors: Arts. 13(2)-(4), 31; Annex II item 5; Annex VII
label_applies_when: Reached part: integrity and logging of material-identification, lot-release and chamber-sensing data handled by an AM product.
not_covered: Composition, contamination and handling of the material itself.

label: Replacement parts and upgrades
source_trace: Y §5.2.2 (replacement parts).
label_applies_when: Direct for software, firmware, security updates and components with digital elements (Articles 3(6) and 13(5), Annex I Part II).
not_covered: Identical spare parts (Article 2(6)). Mechanical and other non-digital parts.

label: AM equipment delivered through the supply chain
source_trace: Y §5.2.2 (AM equipment delivered in a compromised state). K §4.2.13 (supply-chain vulnerabilities of AM equipment).
label_applies_when: The AM equipment itself, as a product with digital elements placed on the market (Articles 2(1) and 3(1)).
not_covered: For equipment that receives data only on removable media, scope rests on Recital 9 and is an interpretation, not settled law.

label: Third-party software, firmware, and service dependencies
source_trace: K §4.2.2 (slicing software, software and firmware vulnerabilities) and §4.2.4. Y §5.1.2 (cyber infrastructure) and §5.2.2 (replacement parts: software and firmware). Split out as the digital dependency class.
label_applies_when: The AM product that integrates the component (Article 13(5)) or relies on remote data processing developed under its manufacturer's responsibility (Article 3(2)).
not_covered: Third-party services outside Article 3(2) are not part of the product. They are handled through component due diligence.

label: Logistics and distribution chain
source_trace: K §3.4 to §3.6 (distribution and logistics, delivered parts, return) and K §4.3.9 Disrupting supply chain logistics, recast as the asset that is attacked.
label_applies_when: Direct for design data and security updates in transit between AM products (points 2(e) and 2(f), Part II points 7 and 8).
not_covered: Transport, storage and custody of physical goods.

label: Manufactured objects in transit or return flows
source_trace: Y §5.2.2 (manufactured object). K §3.5 and §3.6 (delivered parts, return).
label_applies_when: Direct where the object is, or contains, a product with digital elements.
not_covered: Non-digital parts in transit, storage or return.

label: Physical production system assets
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge. Groups Y §5.1.1 to §5.1.3 and K §4.2.12 to §4.2.14.
label_applies_when: Leaves differ: Direct (2.4.2); Conditional (2.4.1, 2.4.4); Partial (2.4.3).
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Final manufactured part
source_trace: Y §5.1.1 Manufactured part (fit and form, function, contamination). K §4.2.12 Final manufactured part.
label_applies_when: Direct where the part is, or contains, a product with digital elements.
not_covered: A purely mechanical part. The digital manipulation that produced a defective part is recorded under its method node.

label: AM equipment
source_trace: Y §5.1.2 AM equipment (mechanical, electrical, cyber infrastructure, explosion or fire). K §4.2.13 AM equipment.
label_applies_when: The AM, post-processing or inspection equipment with a direct or indirect data connection (Article 2(1)).
not_covered: See 2.3.3 for equipment fed only by removable media.

label: AM production environment
source_trace: K §4.2.14 AM production environment.
annex_i_requirements: Annex I.I(1), (2)(h), (i), (j), (k), (l); Annex II items 4, 5, and 8
label_applies_when: Reached part: resilience, monitoring and incident-impact reduction of the AM product under its documented conditions of use, and the Annex II user information on the operating environment.
not_covered: Site conditions, facility security and utilities.

label: Downstream environment affected through AM equipment or a deployed part
source_trace: Y §5.1.3 Environment (affected through AM equipment or through the manufactured part).
annex_i_requirements: Annex I.I(1), (2)(h), (i), (k); Annex II items 4, 5, and 8
label_applies_when: Direct where the affected environment is another device or network reached through the AM product (point 2(i)), or where the deployed part is itself a product with digital elements.
not_covered: Physical harm caused by a defective non-digital part. Article 13(2) still requires the risk assessment to consider impact on health and safety.

label: Rights, governance, and restricted-object targets
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge. Groups K §4.2.5 to §4.2.8.
label_applies_when: All leaves carry this label. See the leaf rows.
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Intellectual property rights and legally protected knowledge
source_trace: K §4.2.5 Intellectual property right (labelled Infringement in K Table 3). Y §4 (technical data as protected knowledge).
label_applies_when: Reached part: access control, confidentiality, logging and secure deletion for protected knowledge held in an AM product.
not_covered: Ownership, infringement and enforcement of IP rights.

label: Unauthorised overproduction
source_trace: K §4.2.6 Unauthorised overproduction. The digital encoding of the limit follows Y §4.2.4 (licensing enforced by DRM, device binding).
label_applies_when: Reached part: integrity, access control and logging of production limits that an AM product enforces as data (licence, print count, validity), against anyone other than the product's user.
not_covered: Overproduction by the product's own user. The commercial limit and its enforcement.

label: Export-controlled parts
source_trace: K §4.2.7 Export-controlled parts. Y Fig. 4 names the category and excludes it from its taxonomy.
label_applies_when: Reached part: access control, confidentiality and logging for controlled technical data held in an AM product.
not_covered: Export-control status, licensing and the physical transfer of parts.

label: Internally restricted parts
source_trace: K §4.2.8 Internally restricted parts.
label_applies_when: Reached part: secure default configuration, access control and logging where an AM product enforces the internal restriction.
not_covered: The content of the internal policy. Production by authorised users.

label: Acquisition and exfiltration methods
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge. Groups Y §4.2.1 to §4.2.3 and K §4.3.1, §4.3.5.
label_applies_when: Leaves differ: Direct (3.1.1); Conditional (3.1.2).
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Theft / intellectual property theft
source_trace: Y §4.2.1 Theft. K §4.3.5 Intellectual property theft.
label_applies_when: Design repository, CAD or build-preparation software, workflow platform, printer or transfer channel from which the data is taken.
not_covered: Use of the data by a person authorised to access it. Legal remedies.

label: Reverse engineering
source_trace: Y §4.2.2 Reverse engineering and Y §4.2.3 AM equipment analysis (a separate top-level method in Y, folded in here as a submethod). K §4.3.1 Reverse engineering of AM design.
label_applies_when: Direct where the reconstruction uses data or interfaces of an AM product: interception of job or tool-path traffic (point 2(e)), analysis of exposed interfaces, file formats or protocols (point 2(j)), or residual data on decommissioned equipment (point 2(m)).
not_covered: Scanning or metrology of a lawfully obtained part. Acoustic, thermal, electromagnetic and power side channels are not expressly addressed by Annex I.

label: Protection-circumvention and unauthorised reproduction methods
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge. Groups Y §4.2.4 and K §4.3.4, §4.3.6.
label_applies_when: Leaves differ: Direct (3.2.1); Mostly outside CRA (3.2.2).
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Bypassing digital and physical protection / protection removal
source_trace: Y §4.2.4 Protection removal. K §4.3.4 Bypassing digital and physical protection.
label_applies_when: AM product that implements the protection: licensing or DRM module, access control, signature check, device binding or firmware safeguard.
not_covered: Circumvention by the product's own user. Physical barriers that are not part of the product.

label: Counterfeiting / unlicensed reproduction
source_trace: K §4.3.6 Counterfeiting part protection, together with the reproduction threats K lists under §4.1.1, §4.1.2 and §4.2.5.
legal_anchors: Art. 13(2)-(3), for the risk assessment only
label_applies_when: None. Producing or selling copies does not operate on an AM product without its user's authorisation. Record the enabling step under 3.1.1, 3.1.2 or 3.2.1.
not_covered: Counterfeiting, unlicensed reproduction and grey-market sale as legal and commercial acts.

label: Design and specification tampering methods
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge. Groups Y §5.2.1 and K §4.3.8.
annex_i_requirements: Annex I.I(2)(d), (f), (j), (l); Annex VII points 2, 3, and 6
label_applies_when: All leaves carry this label. See the leaf rows.
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Part specification tampering
source_trace: Y §5.2.1 3D part specification (geometry, required properties, source material). K §4.3.8 Tempering with part specification (sic).
label_applies_when: Design software, repository or platform through which the specification is changed.
not_covered: None beyond the general limits of Section C.4.

label: CAD/STL/intermediate-representation tampering
source_trace: K §4.2.9 and §4.2.10 (sabotage and design tampering of CAD and STL files) and K §4.3.13 (design file manipulation). Y §5.2.1 (part geometry) and §5.2.5 (model altered by compromised software or firmware). Split from 3.3.1 by artefact.
label_applies_when: Design software, conversion tool, repository or workstation software through which the file is changed.
not_covered: Metadata lost by design in a format conversion, which is not an attack.

label: Tool-path and execution-file tampering
source_trace: K §4.2.11 (tampering with tool paths, malicious code in tool-path generation) and K §4.3.2 (tool path manipulation). Split from 3.3.1 by artefact.
label_applies_when: Slicer, job-transfer channel, machine-control software or firmware through which the instructions are changed.
not_covered: None beyond the general limits of Section C.4.

label: Process tampering methods
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge. Groups Y §5.2.3, parts of §5.1.2 and §5.2.5, and K §4.3.10.
annex_i_requirements: Annex I.I(2)(d), (f), (h), (j), (k), (l); Annex VII points 2 and 3
label_applies_when: Leaves differ: Direct (3.4.1, 3.4.2, 3.4.3, 3.4.4); Conditional (3.4.5).
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Compromising AM process parameters
source_trace: Y §5.2.3 AM manufacturing process (stored parameters). K §4.3.10 Compromising AM process parameters (labelled Corrupting in K Figure 3).
label_applies_when: Slicer, machine-profile store or printer that holds the parameters as configuration.
not_covered: None beyond the general limits of Section C.4.

label: Process-control manipulation
source_trace: Y §5.2.3 (process control). K §4.3.12 (print process manipulation). Split from 3.4.1 to separate live control from stored parameters.
label_applies_when: Machine-control software, firmware, HMI or controller interface of the AM equipment.
not_covered: None beyond the general limits of Section C.4.

label: Sensor-information falsification
source_trace: Y §5.2.3 (sensor information).
annex_i_requirements: Annex I.I(2)(e), (f), (h), (l); Annex VII points 2, 3, and 6
label_applies_when: Printer, monitoring system or quality software whose sensor data path is manipulated.
not_covered: Physical spoofing of the measured quantity at the sensor.

label: Timing disruption
source_trace: Y §5.1.2 (cyber infrastructure) lists timing as a property of the cyber infrastructure that can be attacked. Recast here as a method.
label_applies_when: Machine-control network, job queue or controller whose message timing or order is manipulated.
not_covered: Delays with a purely physical cause.

label: Power manipulation / power surge
source_trace: Y §5.2.5 Compromised AM equipment (power surge).
label_applies_when: Direct where the power behaviour is commanded through compromised AM products, for example a coordinated power draw (points 2(f) and 2(i)).
not_covered: Manipulation of the external electrical supply.

label: Post-processing tampering methods
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge. Groups Y §5.2.4 and K §4.3.11.
annex_i_requirements: Annex I.I(2)(d), (f), (h), (l); Annex VII points 2 and 3
label_applies_when: All leaves carry this label. See the leaf rows.
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Post-processing procedure tampering
source_trace: Y §5.2.4 Post-processing. K §4.3.11 Tempering with post-processing procedures (sic).
label_applies_when: Direct where recipes, programmes, work instructions or inspection settings are held in, or executed by, a digitally controlled post-processing or inspection product.
not_covered: Manual deviations, material substitution and physical concealment of defects.

label: Heat-treatment manipulation
source_trace: Y §5.2.4 (heat treatment).
label_applies_when: Direct where the heat-treatment cycle is set or controlled through a furnace or HIP controller with digital elements.
not_covered: Manual or physical alteration of the treatment.

label: Finish-machining manipulation
source_trace: Y §5.2.4 (finish machining).
label_applies_when: Direct where machining programmes, offsets or surface-finish settings are held in, or executed by, a CNC, EDM or similar controller.
not_covered: Manual finishing.

label: Supply-chain compromise methods
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge. Groups Y §5.2.2 and K §4.3.7, §4.3.9.
label_applies_when: Leaves differ: Direct (3.6.4); Conditional (3.6.1, 3.6.3, 3.6.5); Partial (3.6.2, 3.6.6).
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Exploitation of supply-chain weaknesses
source_trace: Y §5.2.2 Supply chain attack. K §4.3.7 Exploitation of supply chain weaknesses.
label_applies_when: Direct where the weakness lies in third-party software, firmware, a digital component, an update or maintenance channel, or a remote service of an AM product (Article 13(5), Annex I Part II).
not_covered: Non-digital suppliers, materials and supplier governance.

label: Feedstock compromise
source_trace: Y §5.2.2 (feedstock). K §4.3.7 (counterfeiting material).
label_applies_when: Reached part: integrity and logging of material-identification, lot-release and sensing data in an AM product.
not_covered: Alteration, contamination or substitution of the material itself.

label: Replacement-parts compromise
source_trace: Y §5.2.2 (replacement parts).
label_applies_when: Direct for compromised software, firmware, updates or components with digital elements.
not_covered: Identical spare parts (Article 2(6)). Mechanical and other non-digital parts.

label: AM equipment compromise before deployment
source_trace: Y §5.2.2 (AM equipment).
label_applies_when: The AM equipment as delivered: firmware, software, hardware and default configuration.
not_covered: See 2.3.3 for equipment fed only by removable media.

label: Manufactured-object compromise in logistics
source_trace: Y §5.2.2 (manufactured object: replacement, cyber infection).
label_applies_when: Direct where the object is, or contains, a product with digital elements, for example infection of embedded electronics.
not_covered: Physical replacement, contamination or tampering of a non-digital part.

label: Disrupting supply-chain logistics
source_trace: K §4.3.9 Disrupting supply chain logistics.
label_applies_when: Reached part: secure and timely distribution of security updates (Part II points 7 and 8) and availability of remote services on which the AM product depends.
not_covered: Transport, warehousing, routing and custody. Logistics IT is regulated as a product in its own right, not as an AM product.

label: Equipment-compromise methods
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge. Groups Y §5.2.5 and K §4.3.2, §4.3.3, §4.3.12.
label_applies_when: Leaves differ: Direct (3.7.1, 3.7.3, 3.7.4); Partial (3.7.2).
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Cyber intrusion on AM equipment
source_trace: K §4.3.2 Cyber intrusion on AM equipment. Y §5.2.5 Compromised AM equipment (cyber attacks).
label_applies_when: The AM equipment and its control environment: firmware, machine-control software, HMI and remote-maintenance interface.
not_covered: None beyond the general limits of Section C.4.

label: Physical sabotage on AM equipment
source_trace: K §4.3.3 Physical sabotage on AM equipment.
label_applies_when: Reached part: limitation of physical interfaces as attack surface (point 2(j)), incident-impact reduction (2(k)), availability (2(h)) and logging (2(l)) of the AM equipment.
not_covered: Mechanical damage, vandalism, contamination and facility security.

label: Manipulating 3D equipment
source_trace: K §4.3.12 Manipulating 3D equipment.
label_applies_when: The AM equipment whose settings, safeguards or machine profile are changed without authorisation.
not_covered: Reconfiguration by the product's own user. Hardware manipulation (see 3.7.2).

label: Compromised AM equipment as a method-enabler
source_trace: Y §5.2.5 Compromised AM equipment (as the route that enables other methods) and Y §4.2.1 (compromised equipment as a theft vector).
label_applies_when: The compromised AM equipment, including its update channel and vulnerability handling.
not_covered: None beyond the general limits of Section C.4.

label: Part-compromise methods
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge. Groups Y §5.2.6, §5.1.1 and K §4.3.13.
label_applies_when: All leaves carry this label. See the leaf rows.
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Compromising 3D-printed parts
source_trace: K §4.3.13 Compromising 3D-printed parts. Y §5.2.6 Compromised part is mapped to 3.8.2, not to this node.
label_applies_when: Direct where the defect is introduced by manipulating data, parameters or instructions in an AM product (record it together with the 3.3 or 3.4 node used), or where the part is itself a product with digital elements.
not_covered: Physical or material alteration of a non-digital part.

label: Contamination and embedded-component insertion
source_trace: Y §5.2.6 Compromised part and Y §5.1.1 (contamination: embedded items, NBC contamination).
label_applies_when: Direct where the inserted item is software or hardware with digital elements (Articles 3(6) and 13(5)).
not_covered: Material, chemical, biological or radiological contamination. Passive foreign objects.

label: Context-exploitation and destabilisation methods
source_trace: Family introduced by the merge. Groups K §4.3.14 and K's exploited opportunities.
legal_anchors: Art. 13(2)-(3), for the risk assessment only
label_applies_when: All leaves carry this label. See the leaf rows.
not_covered: See the leaf rows.

label: Exploitation of economic and market instability
source_trace: K §4.3.14 Exploitation of economic and market instability.
legal_anchors: Art. 13(2)-(3), for the risk assessment only
label_applies_when: None. Record the attack that the instability enables under its own method node.
not_covered: Inflation, shortages, market manipulation and misinformation.

label: Exploitation of natural or man-made disruption windows
source_trace: K's exploited opportunities (natural disruptions, man-made events) and the non-adversarial sub-threats of K §4.1.5, recast as a method.
legal_anchors: Art. 13(2)-(3), for the risk assessment only
label_applies_when: None. Record the attack carried out in the disruption window under its own method node. Article 13(2) and (3) still require the risk assessment to consider foreseeable conditions of use.
not_covered: Disasters, strikes, conflict and emergency operations.
